activeGoal.title: PocketMonster production browser ↔ VPS authenticated gameplay

work.title: Freeze one backend ingress
work.objective: Preserve the verified frontend roles (Firebase auth/launcher → GitHub Pages game/runtime) while replacing backend raw-IP/ingress drift with one stable HTTPS/WSS origin; keep the application listener loopback-only.
inspect: PocketMonster .github/workflows/firebase-hosting-merge.yml, firebase-launcher-entry.mjs, launch-bootstrap.mjs, runtime-config.json and CSP connect-src
VPS reverse-proxy/tunnel/public-url configuration through authenticated private access
Current public HTTPS /api/health and WSS /ws/chat routing
acceptance: Firebase remains explicitly the auth/launch-ticket launcher and GitHub Pages remains explicitly the game/runtime host unless a separate migration is approved
apiBaseUrl, webSocketUrl, CSP connect-src, deployment verifier, Server.PublicUrl and ingress configuration resolve to the same stable backend origin
HTTPS /api/health succeeds through that backend origin
WSS upgrade succeeds through that backend origin
no second public application port is required
doNot: Do not publish private VPS repository names, paths, credentials or machine configuration in public Project Brain.
Do not open another raw VPS application port.
Do not use a rotating quick-tunnel URL as production runtime-config.
Do not treat the intentional Firebase launcher → GitHub Pages runtime handoff as the backend-ingress defect.

work.title: Close server contract parity
work.objective: Promote the canonical server contract required by the merged Pocket/Pirate client.
acceptance: canonical server source exposes the required routes/operations
exact-head contract tests are SAT
client and server operation names/payload semantics match
doNot: Do not treat client CI as proof of server endpoint support.

work.title: Pin one Pirate worker artifact
work.objective: Build and deploy the VPS Pirate worker from the exact reviewed Pirate source used by the shipped release.
acceptance: release manifest pins Pirate source SHA
worker artifacts have recorded SHA-256
CI rejects stale or mismatched worker source
doNot: Do not infer worker parity from repository branch names or commit messages.

work.title: Prove runtime readiness
work.objective: Prove the running VPS process has the reviewed worker bound and the public origin is ready for browser traffic.
acceptance: read-only readiness reports worker contract/version/hash without secrets
HTTPS health/version SAT from public origin
CORS preflight SAT
WSS upgrade/auth readiness SAT
doNot: Do not expose credentials or machine paths from readiness endpoints.

work.title: Run real browser QA
work.objective: Complete one QA-only authenticated browser transaction across Firebase launcher → GitHub Pages Pocket runtime → VPS → Pirate gameplay, without treating that proof as general-player admission.
acceptance: approved QA login and launch-ticket issue/redeem SAT
authenticated WSS SAT
Pirate state GET SAT
vitals input POST SAT
one idempotent Pirate operation SAT
result is labeled QA-authenticated scope and does not claim general-player admission
doNot: Do not enable broad production player/economy writes only to diagnose connectivity.
Do not infer general-player multiplayer availability from the one-user QA allowlist.

work.title: Promote live-host authority
work.objective: Promote only scopes proven by P0-P4. Preserve general-player admission as VIOL/BLOCKED while the rollout remains QA-scoped.
acceptance: P0-P4 are SAT with evidence for the QA-authenticated path
QA-authenticated live-host integration status is updated only for that proven scope
general-player admission remains VIOL/BLOCKED unless a separate admission rollout has deterministic evidence
new checkpoint and tests preserve UNKNOWN ≠ PASS
doNot: Do not promote from documentation-only or health-only proof.
Do not collapse QA-authenticated SAT and general-player admission into one verdict.
